formal_result: For each of the 256 possible (c0,c1) nibble offsets in the original carry law, its third mixed XOR derivative over target-current input bits 0 and 1 and source-current input bit 0, at zero input, is nonzero. All GF(2) polynomials of degree <=2 in those 20 public input bits have third mixed derivative identically zero. Hidden output XOR c2 disappears from the third derivative; therefore none of the original carry-parameter cases is exactly representable by either of the compared 211-term quadratic models.
provenance_note: Algebraic verification of source-only deterministic engineering laws, NOT a new original scientific first-use source; no reexecution of 924–937 original evidence.
